questions.question: Apply Herzberg to a call centre with high turnover. Propose changes

points.text: Hygiene factors: pay, conditions, supervision, policy -> ensure competitive pay, ergonomic chairs, supportive managers, fair policies. Motivators: achievement, recognition, responsibility, growth -> team targets with bonuses, employee of month, job enrichment (team leader roles), career path to management
